entries.name: 잊힌 항로의 나침반
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one square inventory thumbnail for a cozy fishing game, new rare relic 잊힌 항로의 나침반. Single ancient bronze nautical compass relic, rounded weathered bronze housing tilted in three-quarter view, cracked glass lid, turquoise needle pointing into a faint curled turquoise breeze, faded engraved navigation markings without letters. A small archaeological treasure from a sunken ship. Cozy rounded cartoon proportions, crisp dark brown contour lines and warm soft cel shading. No face, no animal. Reference only establishes rendering style, never copy otter, hook or starfish. Entire object centered, at least 12 percent transparent margin on every side, readable at 64px. Actual transparent alpha PNG. No text, no labels, no UI, no background scenery, no floor, no checkerboard, no border, no watermark. Do not draw a rarity badge.
